title: Venomous Fang
summary: Alchemy ingredient for Serpent Fang Toxin.

fields.Alchemy: Extract 3 Venomous Fangs into Suspension of Snake Venom. Combine with any Vitriol for Serpent Fang Toxin.
fields.Acquisition: Derryth Bonecloak in the Underdark’s Myconid Colony.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
